items.stem: Which TWO comparison operators are valid in PowerShell? (Select TWO)

options.rationale: == is not a PowerShell comparison operator.
> is redirection in PowerShell, not comparison.

items.explanation: Correct: PowerShell uses word operators such as -eq and -gt, not == or >.
